verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single changelog entry announcing 'Secret variables in environments', which points to the masked-secrets path of the story. Nothing documents how those secrets are masked or whether they stay out of shared or synced collections and environments. There is no evidence of any external vault integration. Missing for 10: documentation of secret masking and of secrets being excluded from shared/exported files, external vault integration (e.g. HashiCorp Vault or a cloud secret manager), independent or hands-on corroboration.
